_comment: Tier-2: SlidingCableElement3D3N REQUIRES CONSTITUTIVE_LAW on Properties — its Init() errors by name if it is missing, unlike RingElement and EmpiricalSpringElement which read properties directly. Pitfall (kratos.cable_net #6, edge 1 of three). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). With YOUNG_MODULUS, DENSITY and CROSS_AREA set but no law, Initialize raises 'Error: A constitutive law needs to be specified for the element with ID 1'; adding SMA.TrussConstitutiveLaw() — the 1D law the claim recommends — makes the same Initialize succeed. Only edge 1 of this three-part claim is covered; edges 2 (mIsCompressed silent zero-stiffness) and 3 (FRICTION_COEFFICIENT Capstan sliding) need a converged multi-step solve and are named in the report as not yet done. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
